item.title: 大阪京都吃什麼？私藏3家必吃餐廳公開！沒帶現金也能完成付款的關西美食之旅
item.itunes:title: 大阪京都吃什麼？私藏3家必吃餐廳公開！沒帶現金也能完成付款的關西美食之旅
item.itunes:author: 3cTim哥生活日常
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYqyHpLVJBI

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解如何在日本使用 Binance Pay 串接 PayPay，讓支援 PayPay 的店家成為旅途中更多元的付款選擇。
  • 掌握掃碼付款流程、出發前的帳戶安全設定，以及付款時需要核對的資訊。
  • 一次認識大阪與京都的拉麵、咖啡廳和窯烤披薩推薦，並了解這種付款方式的適用限制。
  • 了解支援的數位資產、匯率與退款注意事項，以及影片提及的限時優惠。

摘要

關西美食之旅與付款實測

作者帶著同行者走訪大阪與京都的私房餐廳，並在旅途中測試以 Binance Pay 串接日本 PayPay 付款。大阪行程中，他們前往一家評價很高、提供蔬食拉麵選項的拉麵店；作者也提醒，造訪前應留意店家的預約要求。

Binance Pay 付款方式與準備事項

作者說明，符合資格並完成身分驗證的訪日旅客，可以在支援 PayPay 的店家使用 Binance Pay 付款，不必申辦日本 PayPay 帳戶或當地銀行帳戶。付款時可出示自己的付款碼讓店家掃描，也可掃描店家的 PayPay QR Code，輸入金額後確認付款。出發前應先完成註冊與 KYC 身分驗證，並開啟雙重驗證及 Passkey 等安全設定。

大阪實測、費用與付款確認

作者在大阪難波一間小店掃描 PayPay QR Code，支付 1,450 日圓，並以此展示付款流程。作者認為，這種方式能增加在地方小店付款的便利性，也可減少攜帶現金與處理零錢的麻煩，或作為信用卡無法使用時的備用選項。不過，付款前仍須仔細核對店名、金額、扣款資產與數量；交易雖不收區塊鏈 Gas Fee，仍須留意即時換匯報價。

京都餐廳推薦與適用限制

接著，作者前往京都推薦的窯烤拿坡里披薩店，介紹四種起司蜂蜜披薩與加鋪芝麻葉的馬格麗特披薩，並提醒店家需要預約。付款完成後，應等畫面顯示成功並讓店員確認再離開。作者也提到，若店家不支援 PayPay，可考慮使用 Binance Card 搭配 Apple Pay；但線上購物、部分計程車、自動販賣機，以及限定使用 PayPay 餘額的情境，可能無法透過這項方式付款。退款則須依交易規則處理，不一定能退回相同數量的數位資產。

支援資產與優惠提醒

作者總結，這項服務讓持有數位資產的旅客多了一種日常付款管道，但實際使用前仍要確認店家是否支援，並留意即時匯率及所選扣款幣種。影片提及的支援資產包括 USDT、USDC、BTC、ETH 與 BNB；符合資格的國際旅客在日本支援 PayPay 的店家付款，還可能享有影片所述的限時 10% 折扣。

=============

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYqyHpLVJBI

去日本旅遊不用特別換日幣？！這次帶大家實測 Binance Pay × PayPay，在大阪、京都的餐廳與小店實際付款，究竟有多方便？完整教學 Binance Pay 付款流程、使用限制與注意事項，符合資格還能享限時 10% 折扣！

item.title: 大家都開箱完了，我用一週才發現！新款iPad mini真正好用與不好用的地方
item.itunes:title: 大家都開箱完了，我用一週才發現！新款iPad mini真正好用與不好用的地方
item.itunes:author: 3cTim哥生活日常
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SnubvI-oWbY

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解新款 iPad mini 的便攜性與單手握持優勢，評估其是否符合隨身攜帶的生活需求。
  • 掌握不同儲存容量背後所隱藏的處理器核心規格差異，避免花費預算盲目升級。
  • 透過與 iPhone 及其他平板的定位比較，清楚釐清自身在手寫筆記、閱讀與娛樂上的實際購買價值。

摘要

極致便攜性與螢幕表現的全面進化

作者 Ting 哥在經過一週的深度體驗後指出，新款 iPad mini 最無可取代的核心價值在於其極佳的隨身便利性。機身重量僅 263 公克且厚度縮減至 5.4 公釐，帶來接近完美單手握持的手感，讓使用者無論在床上閱讀、沙發追劇或外出收納都能毫無負擔。螢幕方面升級為 8.3 吋 Liquid Retina 顯示器，全螢幕亮度達 600 尼特、HDR 峰值亮度可達 1200 尼特，並支援最低 1 尼特的暗光閱讀，黑階對比與色彩表現皆有顯著提升，不過螢幕依然維持 60Hz 更新率，是追求極致流暢度使用者的最大遺憾。

晶片規格差異與生產力配件定位

use. At home, I use it to read the news , watch shows, or read in bed without needing to sit at a desk or use a keyboard. very close to a digital notepad. your own 35W USB-C charger for fast charging. Another major improvement is the IP67 water resistance. The new model removes the traditional speaker grilles in favor of an under-display acoustic structure. If you turn the volume all the way up, it still distorts slightly, so I find it’s most comfortable at around 85%. Also, the front camera has been moved to. the landscape bezel, so when using FaceTime or joining video calls, the camera position feels much more natural . The rear camera is still 12 megapixels , so scanning documents, capturing whiteboards, or taking casual photos is no problem, though it’s not the main reason to buy this iPad. If you already have an iPhone, does the iPad mini feel redundant? There is indeed some overlap between the two; both are devices that sit right between a phone and a large tablet. cellular capabilities. The iPad mini offers a larger 8.3-inch display, support for Apple Pencil Pro, a full iPadOS experience, and an aspect ratio better suited for long-term reading and creation. I wouldn't recommend upgrading to 512GB just for one extra CPU core; you should first ask yourself if you’ll really be running heavy on-device AI or intensive creative tasks on this small tablet. iPadOS 18 allows the iPad Mini to run multiple tasks, and it can connect to external displays, keyboards. , and mice, but after using it, I feel the most comfortable state is still just having two apps open side-by-side. Apple didn't release an official Magic Keyboard for it, so if you need to type for long periods, you'll need to connect a Bluetooth keyboard or use a third-party keyboard case; it’s more like a portable notebook, reader, and entertainment device, not a shrunk-down MacBook. The iPad Mini also supports the Apple Pencil Pro, so for quick note-taking, signing, marking up documents, or sketching, this size is.

very close to a digital notepad. The Apple Pencil Pro supports squeeze, barrel roll, and Find My features, so it's more complete for creative tasks than previous versions, but keep in mind this pencil is sold separately, and the total price gets quite close to an iPad Air, doesn't it? But if you don't need handwriting or drawing at all, this advantage won't hold much meaning for you. The device is actually thinner this time with a slightly smaller battery capacity, but Apple still claims the same 10-hour battery life. Foreign media tested the video loop playback, and it. lasted 10 hours and 10 minutes, which is actually quite consistent with the official rating. After using it for a week, including watching videos, checking emails, viewing photos, editing , and using AI to remove backgrounds, it basically gets me through a day of intermittent use. The real improvement is the fast charging; paired with a 35W or higher charger, it hits 50%in about 30 minutes, which is much more convenient than the previous generation . However, it comes with a 20W charger in the box, so you’ll need to provide.

your own 35W USB-C charger for fast charging. Another major improvement is the IP67 water resistance. It’s not meant for underwater use, and it doesn’t mean water damage is covered by warranty , but if you get caught in the rain while traveling, you can at least have more peace of mind. The new model removes the traditional speaker grilles in favor of an under-display acoustic structure. If you turn the volume all the way up, it still distorts slightly, so I find it’s most comfortable at around 85%. Also, the front camera has been moved to. the landscape bezel, so when using FaceTime or joining video calls, the camera position feels much more natural . The rear camera is still 12 megapixels , so scanning documents, capturing whiteboards, or taking casual photos is no problem, though it’s not the main reason to buy this iPad. If you already have an iPhone, does the iPad mini feel redundant? There is indeed some overlap between the two; both are devices that sit right between a phone and a large tablet. The iPhone's biggest advantage is, of course, that you can pull it out of your pocket and use it instantly, plus it has a full phone camera and.

cellular capabilities. The iPad mini offers a larger 8.3-inch display, support for Apple Pencil Pro, a full iPadOS experience, and an aspect ratio better suited for long-term reading and creation. So, if you just want a screen larger than your phone but you already own an iPhone, the necessity of an iPad mini actually decreases. But if you need handwriting, read a lot of documents, play games, or perhaps want an independent device that won't be interrupted by phone notifications, the iPad mini is still very satisfying. The iPad mini remains the most well-rounded small-sized tablet available. Those are my thoughts from this experience, anything else?
